AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description: This app manages a small, private list of text notes. Operational Patterns: - Use 'createNote' to add a new note with a title and body content. - Use 'listNotes' to retrieve every note currently stored. - Use 'deleteNote' to remove a note by the id returned from 'createNote' or 'listNotes'. Constraints: - Notes are stored only on this device, in memory, for this demo.
